verse.verse_3: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!
verse.verse_4: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths
verse.verse_5: And the mountains will become as carded wool.
verse.verse_6: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works),
verse.verse_7: He will live a pleasant life.
verse.verse_8: But as for him whose scales are light,
verse.verse_9: A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother,
verse.verse_10: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is! -
